bio: Caileth is the sole survivor of the House of the Rose, after her father Archduke Tethrian invited a deadly magic plague – the Rose Curse. Caileth brought down her own father to end it, and while the Curse still marks her body, what did not kill her has made her stronger. Much, much stronger.
